qsm-langdev check.description: Compare the working tree against a reference commit through every selected checker (exit 3 = worse)

args.name: dir
args.description: repository path (defaults to cwd)

args.name: path
args.description: a file or directory, relative to the repository, for the checkers that score the given set (defaults to the whole repository)

args.name: against
args.description: reference commit (defaults to HEAD)

args.name: at
args.description: enforcement point (defaults to pre-commit)

args.name: lang
args.description: comma-separated languages, overriding the repository's selection

args.name: allFindings
args.description: report every current finding, not only the newly occurring ones

qsm-langdev list.description: Show the checker registry: name, language, enforcement point, extensions, install

qsm-langdev doctor.description: Report which checker binaries are present, with install commands for the rest

args.name: dir
args.description: repository path (defaults to cwd)

qsm-langdev languages.description: List, add, or remove the languages this repository gates on

args.name: action
args.description: what to do with the selection (defaults to list)

args.name: name
args.description: the language, for add and remove

qsm-langdev init.description: Scaffold a profile's per-tool configs for the languages this repository holds

args.name: dir
args.description: repository path (defaults to cwd)

args.name: profile
args.description: profile name; absent keeps whatever the repository already records

args.name: target
args.description: <language>=<target>, e.g. ts=browser

qsm-langdev structure.description: Compare a commit's sentrux architecture quality with the working tree's (exit 3 = worse)

args.name: path
args.description: the tree to score (defaults to cwd)

args.name: against
args.description: reference commit (defaults to HEAD, or the agent's start point with --session)

args.name: session
args.description: session id whose start point in each tree is the reference

args.name: agent
args.description: agent id; with --session and no path, every tree that agent edited is judged

qsm-langdev install.description: Write this repo's pre-commit and pre-push git hooks (appends to an existing hook)

args.name: dir
args.description: repository path (defaults to cwd)

args.name: lang
args.description: hook script language (defaults to sh)

qsm-langdev uninstall.description: Take exactly what install added back out of the git hooks

args.name: dir
args.description: repository path (defaults to cwd)

qsm-langdev edited.description: Compare one edited file against HEAD and answer the findings text the edit hook gives the model

args.name: file
args.description: the absolute path of the file that was edited

args.name: session
args.description: the session that edited it

args.name: agent
args.description: the agent that edited it (absent for the main agent)

qsm-langdev hook.description: Run the gates this repo selected for a hook point (what the installed hooks call)

args.name: name
args.description: the enforcement point to run
